18202-the-growth-of-thought-as-affecting.title: The Growth Of Thought As Affecting The Progress Of Society
18202-the-growth-of-thought-as-affecting.creator: William Withington.
18202-the-growth-of-thought-as-affecting.description: A book by William Withington.. A contemporary thus reveals the state of mind, through which he has come to the persuasion of great insight into the realities, which stand behind the veil: "What more natural, more spontaneous, more imperative, than that the conditions of his future being should press themselves on his anxious thought! Should we not suppose, the 'every third thought would be his grave,' together with the momentous realities that lie beyond it?

34355-marching-on-niagara-or-the-soldier.title: Marching On Niagara Or The Soldier Boys Of The Old Frontier
34355-marching-on-niagara-or-the-soldier.creator: Unknown
34355-marching-on-niagara-or-the-soldier.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "I'll tell you better about that when we are on our way home, Dave. I certainly saw the hoof-prints down by the salt lick this morning. That proves they can't be far off. My idea is that at least three deer are just beyond the lower creek, although I may be mistaken."

arxiv-2011-13632.title: Impact Probability Under Aleatory And Epistemic Uncertainties
arxiv-2011-13632.creator: Chiara Tardioli, Davide Farnocchia, Massimiliano Vasile, Steve R. Chesley
arxiv-2011-13632.description: Abstract We present an approach to estimate an upper bound for the impact probability of a potentially hazardous asteroid when part of the force model depends on unknown parameters whose statistical distribution needs to be assumed. As case study we consider Apophis’ risk assessment for the 2036 and 2068 keyholes based on information available as of 2013.

arxiv-2102-10625.title: Spin excitations in the heavily overdoped monolayer graphene superconductor: An analog to the cuprates
arxiv-2102-10625.creator: Wei-Jie Lin 1, W. LiMing 1, Tao Zhou 1,2
arxiv-2102-10625.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Wei-Jie Lin 1, W. LiMing 1, Tao Zhou 1,2. Recently it was reported experimentally that the monolayer graphene can be heavily overdoped to beyond the Van Hove regime. We study theoretically the possible superconductivity and the corresponding spin excitations of the monolayer graphene in this doping region. A static spin-density-wave state is favorable due to the nested Fermi surface as the Fermi level is doped to the Van Hove singularity point. Superconductivity may be realized upon further doping.

arxiv-2105-07569.title: DeepMerge: Learning to Merge Programs
arxiv-2105-07569.creator: Elizabeth Dinella, Todd Mytkowicz, Alexey Svyatkovskiy, Christian Bird, Mayur Naik, Shuvendu Lahiri
arxiv-2105-07569.description: Abstract In collaborative software development, program merging is the mechanism to integrate changes from multiple programmers. Merge algorithms in modern version control systems report a conflict when changes interfere textually. Merge conflicts require manual intervention and frequently stall modern continuous integration pipelines.

arxiv-2112-10833.title: Understanding User Perspectives on Prompts for Brief Reflection on Troubling Emotions DOI: 10.1145/1122445.1122456 CCS: Human-centered computing Human computer interaction (HCI)
arxiv-2112-10833.creator: Ananya Bhattacharjee, Pan Chen, Linjia Zhou, Abhijoy Mandal, Jai Aggarwal, Katie O’Leary, Anne Hsu, Alex Mariakakis, Joseph Jay Williams
arxiv-2112-10833.description: Abstract . We investigate users’ perspectives on an online reflective question activity (RQA) that prompts people to externalize their underlying emotions on a troubling situation. Inspired by principles of cognitive behavioral therapy, our 15-minute activity encourages self-reflection without a human or automated conversational partner.

arxiv-2212-07980.title: Numerical Study of Magnetic Island Coalescence Using Magnetohydrodynamics With Adaptively Embedded Particle-In-Cell Model
arxiv-2212-07980.creator: Dion Li, Yuxi Chen, Chuanfei Dong, Liang Wang, Gabor Toth
arxiv-2212-07980.description: Abstract Collisionless magnetic reconnection typically requires kinetic treatments that are, in general, computationally expensive compared to fluid-based models. In this study, we use the magnetohydrodynamics with adaptively embedded particle-in-cell (MHD-AEPIC) model to study the interaction of two magnetic flux ropes.

arxiv-2301-09617.title: Fully transformer-based biomarker prediction from colorectal cancer histology: a large-scale multicentric study
arxiv-2301-09617.creator: Sophia J. Wagner, Daniel Reisenbüchler, Nicholas P. West, Jan Moritz Niehues, Gregory Patrick Veldhuizen, Philip Quirke, Heike I. Grabsch, Piet A. van den Brandt, Gordon G. A. Hutchins, Susan D. Richman, Tanwei Yuan, Rupert Langer, Josien Christina Anna Jenniskens, Kelly Offermans, Wolfram Mueller,
arxiv-2301-09617.description: Abstract Background: Deep learning (DL) can extract predictive and prognostic biomarkers from routine pathology slides in colorectal cancer. For example, a DL test for the diagnosis of microsatellite instability (MSI) in CRC has been approved in 2022. Current approaches rely on convolutional neural networks (CNNs).

arxiv-2410-00710.title: A potential theory for the Wess–Zumino–Witten equation in the space of Kähler potentials
arxiv-2410-00710.creator: Kuang-Ru Wu
arxiv-2410-00710.description: Abstract We develop a potential theory for the Wess–Zumino–Witten (WZW) equation in the space of Kähler potentials which is parallel to the potential theory for the Hermitian–Yang–Mills equation. A concept called ω \omega -harmonicity on graphs is introduced which characterizes the WZW equation.

arxiv-2412-00154.title: o1-Coder: an o1 Replication for Coding
arxiv-2412-00154.creator: Yuxiang Zhang, Shangxi Wu, Yuqi Yang, Jiangming Shu, Jinlin Xiao, Chao Kong & Jitao Sang
arxiv-2412-00154.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yuxiang Zhang, Shangxi Wu, Yuqi Yang, Jiangming Shu, Jinlin Xiao, Chao Kong & Jitao Sang. The technical report introduces O1-CODER, an attempt to replicate OpenAI’s o1 model with a focus on coding tasks. It integrates reinforcement learning (RL) and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to enhance the model’s System-2 thinking capabilities.

arxiv-2509-18987.title: DTW-Align: Bridging the Modality Gap in End-to-End Speech Translation with Dynamic Time Warping Alignment
arxiv-2509-18987.creator: Abderrahmane Issam, Yusuf Can Semerci, Jan Scholtes, Gerasimos Spanakis
arxiv-2509-18987.description: Abstract End-to-End Speech Translation (E2E-ST) is the task of translating source speech directly into target text bypassing the intermediate transcription step. The representation discrepancy between the speech and text modalities has motivated research on what is known as bridging the modality gap . State-of-the-art methods addressed this by aligning speech and text representations on the word or token level.

arxiv-2510-22430.title: On Integer Programs That Look Like Paths M.P. was supported by the project BOBR that is funded from the European Research Council (ERC) under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme with grant agreement No. 948057. K.P. was supported by the project GA24-11098S of the Czec
arxiv-2510-22430.creator: Marcin Briański, Alexandra Lassota, Kristýna Pekárková, Michał Pilipczuk, Janina Reuter
arxiv-2510-22430.description: Abstract Solving integer programs of the form min { 𝐱 | A 𝐱 = 𝐛 , 𝐥 ⩽ 𝐱 ⩽ 𝐮 , 𝐱 ∈ ℤ n } \min\bigl\{\mathbf{x}\bigm|A\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{b},\mathbf{l}\leqslant\mathbf{x}\leqslant\mathbf{u},\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{Z}^{n}\bigr\} is, in general, 𝖭𝖯 \mathsf{NP} - hard. Hence, great effort has been put into identifying subclasses of integer programs that are solvable in polynomial or 𝖥𝖯𝖳 \mathsf{FPT} time.

arxiv-2512-08375.title: A Characterization of Functional Affine Surface Areas
arxiv-2512-08375.creator: Fernanda M. Baêta
arxiv-2512-08375.description: Abstract A characterization of valuations on the space of convex Lipschitz functions whose domain is a polytope in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} is obtained. It is shown that every upper semicontinuous, equi-affine and dually epi-translation invariant valuation can be written as a linear combination of a constant term, the volume of the domain, and a functional affine surface area.

pmc-10576940.title: Use of a menthol popsicle in managing postoperative thirst in patients undergoing radical prostatectomy: A randomized clinical trial
pmc-10576940.creator: Tâmara Taynah Medeiros da Silva, Fernanda de Castro Teixeira, Sara Cristina Matias de Araújo, Thaís Brunna Maurício Pinheiro, Isabel Karolyne Fernandes Costa, Kleyton Santos de Medeiros, Kátia Regina Barros Ribeiro, Daniele Vieira Dantas, Rodrigo Assis Neves Dantas
pmc-10576940.description: Background and aim: Thirst is a real bother that most patients feel in the immediate postoperative period when they still need to fast. Many approaches regarding symptomatic relief strategies have been described in the literature, but strategies with cold water and/or menthol are effective in quenching thirst, as they act on pre-absorptive mechanisms.

pmc-11482480.title: Utilization of Partial Cytoreductive Nephrectomy in Patients with Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma
pmc-11482480.creator: Nicholas Hauser, Julian Giakas, Hunter Robinson, Facundo Davaro, Zachary Hamilton
pmc-11482480.description: Objectives: Cytoreductive nephrectomy for metastatic renal cell carcinoma (mRCC) is a standard of care. Partial nephrectomy (PN) in the setting of metastatic disease is an uncommon occurrence, and we aimed to characterize its utilization in a modern cohort. Methods: The National Cancer Database was reviewed for patients with mRCC from 2010 to 2017.

pmc-12374924.title: Posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome during epidural labor analgesia: a case report
pmc-12374924.creator: Sadamu Sugimoto, Misako Shimizu, Mariko Takebe, Kousou Matsuura, Tomonori Takazawa
pmc-12374924.description: BackgroundPosterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome (PRES) often presents with a wide range of neurological symptoms, and atypical manifestations can complicate its diagnosis. We report a rare case of peripartum PRES presenting with profound transient retrograde amnesia and orofacial automatisms, notably in the absence of generalized seizures.Case presentationA 29-year-old primigravida developed sustained hypertension during labor.

pmc-12718658.title: Safety and Feasibility of Microporous Polysaccharide Hemosphere Absorbable Hemostat in Robotic Liver Resection: A Single-Center Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-12718658.creator: Takahisa Fujikawa, Yusuke Uemoto, Kei Harada, Keiji Nagata
pmc-12718658.description: Background: Numerous absorbable hemostats are often employed in liver surgery; however, the safety and efficacy of microporous polysaccharide hemosphere (MPH) absorbable hemostats in robotic liver resection (RLR) remain uncertain.Methods: This study included 141 cases that underwent RLR at Kokura Memorial Hospital between September 2021 and May 2025.

pmc-12967089.title: Rethinking Fluid Resuscitation in Septic Shock: A Phase-Adapted, Endothelium-Sparing Approach to Mitigate Capillary Leak
pmc-12967089.creator: Bin Li, Ling Zhao
pmc-12967089.description: Sepsis-induced endothelial dysfunction and the resultant capillary leak syndrome are defining features of septic shock, posing a profound challenge to conventional fluid resuscitation strategies. The long-standing debate over crystalloid versus colloid administration is evolving beyond a simple dichotomy toward a more nuanced, physiologically informed approach.

pmc-13059208.title: Association between serum vitamins and COVID-19 infection: a cross-sectional study of healthcare workers in a Nigerian tertiary hospital
pmc-13059208.creator: Tajudin Adesegun Adetunji, Olusola Akanni Jeje, Temitope Olumuyiwa Ojo, Olufemi Samuel Smith, Olusola Joseph Olarewaju, Baderinwa Opeyemi Akanji, Olusola Fajobi, Taiwo Samson Olumakinde, Waidi Folorunso Sule, Sunday Babatunde Akinde, Rahman Ayodele Bolarinwa
pmc-13059208.description: BackgroundAlthough the global burden of COVID-19 has significantly decreased, understanding the role of micronutrients in modulating immune responses to SARS-CoV-2, especially among vulnerable populations like the healthcare workers, remains very important. This study assessed the association between serum vitamin levels and COVID-19 infection in this high-risk group in a Nigerian tertiary hospital.

pmc-13184591.title: Corticosteroid-resistant Terbinafine-induced Acute Generalized Exanthematous Pustulosis: Therapeutic Challenges and Clinical Infection Overlap
pmc-13184591.creator: Alessandro Svizzero, Camilla Vassallo, Andrea Michelerio, Arber Selimi, Marco Nisi, Giacomo Fiandrino, Valeria Brazzelli
pmc-13184591.description: infection, illustrating the therapeutic and diagnostic challenges that may arise in this setting. A 56-year-old woman developed an itchy, rapidly progressive pustular rash approximately 2 weeks after starting to take 250 mg of oral terbinafine daily for onychomycosis caused by Trichophyton rubrum. She was initially evaluated at another hospital, where Stevens–Johnson syndrome was suspected.

pmc-13213019.title: RNA-based next-generation sequencing strategy for screening MDM2-amplified sarcomas
pmc-13213019.creator: Cheng Lei, Hongjing Zang, Haixia Zhang, Yu He, Min Zhang, Yi Sun, Songqing Fan, Peng Zhou
pmc-13213019.description: The accurate diagnosis of soft tissue sarcomas and bone tumors poses persistent challenges in pathological practice. While targeted RNA-based next-generation sequencing (NGS) has enhanced diagnostic precision through fusion gene detection, its clinical utility remains limited for dedifferentiated liposarcoma (DDLPS) due to the inability to identify MDM2 copy number variations - a critical diagnostic feature.

pmc-13289786.title: Synthesis and characterization of cortinarins – cryptic cyclic peptides from mushrooms of the genus Cortinarius
pmc-13289786.creator: Zhanyu He, Celine Janssen, Joana-Lysiane Schäfer, Agnes Mühlenweg, Simone Kosol, Rene Jarling, Andi Mainz, Bettina G. Keller, Guiyang Yao, Enno Klussmann, Roderich D. Süssmuth

pmc-13530295.title: Translation and validation of the Igbo version of the Warwick–Edinburgh Mental Well-being Scale in Nigeria
pmc-13530295.creator: Ngozi Ekeke, Kingsley N Ukwaja, Amaka Onyima-Esmai, Edmund Ossai, Francis Chinawa, Joseph Chukwu, Charles Nwafor, Anthony Meka, Daniel Egbule, Precious Obioma-Henry, Martin Njoku, Chinwe Eze, Ngozi Murphy-Okpala
pmc-13530295.description: There is growing international interest in the assessment of mental well-being. This study offers lessons learned from the field in the assessment of the validity and the reliability of the Igbo version of the Warwick–Edinburgh Mental Well-being Scale (Igbo-WEMWBS) among adult Igbos in areas affected by Hansen’s disease in southern Nigeria.

pmc-13682350.title: Key genes and pathways of pulmonary hypertension identified by integrating bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing
pmc-13682350.creator: Peipei Wu, Jingru Huan, Chengliang Liu, Haiyang Jin, Ran Wang, Yong Wang, Cheng Cao, Binbin Zhang
pmc-13682350.description: SummaryPulmonary hypertension (PH) is a progressive vascular disease, yet the underlying cell-type-specific molecular networks and diagnostic biomarkers remain incompletely defined. Integrating single-cell and bulk transcriptomics, we identified 14 pulmonary cell types in PH, with smooth muscle cells (SMCs) as a central communication hub interacting with monocytes and macrophages.
